sections.headline: Modern Liver Wellness May Be Falling Short
sections.body: Today's lifestyle wasn't designed with your liver in mind. Processed foods, occasional alcohol, chronic stress, and environmental toxins all place daily pressure on the body's natural detox systems. Many people aren't getting the beneficial plant compounds they need from diet alone — and that gap can show up as bloating, low energy, brain fog, or sluggish digestion without ever knowing the root cause.
bullets: Processed foods & stress burden natural detox pathways
Dietary gaps leave liver resilience unsupported
Bloating, fatigue & brain fog may signal liver load

sections.headline: The Time-Tested Seed That Has Guarded the Liver for Centuries
sections.body: Often called "Nature's Liver Guardian," milk thistle has been used for generations to support liver health and natural resilience. Its key compound — silymarin, standardized to a clinical 80% — has been extensively studied to help support healthy liver enzyme levels, protect liver cells from oxidative stress, and promote the body's natural detox pathways while also supporting comfortable digestion and steady energy.
bullets: 80% silymarin — clinical-threshold standardization
Supports healthy liver enzyme levels naturally
Centuries of traditional use backed by modern research

sections.headline: From Gut Comfort to Glowing Skin — One Daily Capsule
sections.body: Lumora is designed to support multiple interconnected systems. When the liver works well, the whole body follows. Daily use may help support a calmer gut, steadier energy, sharper focus, balanced blood sugar response, and a clearer complexion — all through the same natural detox pathways.
bullets: Gut comfort & reduced occasional bloating
Steady daily energy & mental clarity
Skin clarity, blood sugar balance & recovery

sections.headline: 8 Active Ingredients. Clean. Potent. Plant-Based.
sections.body: Unlike watered-down supplements with filler-heavy blends, Lumora keeps it clean and powerful. Each capsule features clinical-threshold 80% silymarin milk thistle, paired with inositol for metabolic support, turmeric extract for antioxidant protection, and five supporting botanicals — wormwood, clove, pueraria extract, L-methionine, and vitamin C. No fillers. No artificial additives.
bullets: Milk Thistle (80% Silymarin) — liver cell protection & detox support
Inositol + Turmeric (95% Curcuminoids) — metabolic & antioxidant support
Wormwood, Clove & L-Methionine — gentle digestive cleansing

sections.headline: Lumora Is for Anyone Who Wants to Feel Lighter From the Inside Out
sections.body: Lumora is especially helpful for adults dealing with bloating, sluggish digestion, or low afternoon energy — as well as those who drink occasionally and want to give their liver a little extra daily love. It's gentle on the stomach, free from caffeine and stimulants, and designed for consistent daily use as part of a natural wellness routine.

faqs.question: Can I buy Lumora Milk Thistle in stores?
faqs.answer: Lumora Milk Thistle Detox is currently available exclusively through our official website. This lets us ensure the highest quality, freshness, and best pricing directly for our customers.

faqs.question: What ingredients are inside each capsule?
faqs.answer: Each capsule contains 8 active ingredients led by 80% silymarin milk thistle extract, along with inositol, vitamin C, pueraria extract, wormwood, clove, L-methionine, and turmeric extract (95% curcuminoids). No fillers or artificial additives.

faqs.question: How often should I take Lumora?
faqs.answer: Take capsules daily with water, preferably with a morning meal, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Consistent daily use is key for long-term support.

faqs.question: Is Lumora safe to take alongside my current medications?
faqs.answer: Lumora is formulated with natural, plant-based ingredients generally safe for most adults. If you take medications or have existing health concerns, please consult your healthcare provider before starting any new supplement.

faqs.question: How many capsules are in each bottle?
faqs.answer: Each bottle contains 60 capsules — a 1 to 2-month supply depending on daily use — delivering concentrated 80% silymarin milk thistle alongside 7 supporting botanicals per serving.

faqs.question: What if Lumora doesn't work for me?
faqs.answer: We stand behind every bottle. If you're not satisfied for any reason, contact us within 30 days of receiving your order and our team will assist with a return, replacement, or full refund.
